cohort: The participants were women undergoing OB-GYN ED consults or surgeries at a New York City hospital between February 1, 2020, and April 15, 2020.
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic and following a moratorium on elective surgeries, the average weekly volume of ED consults and GYN surgeries decreased, while OB surgeries remained stable, and the distribution of GYN surgical case types shifted towards more emergent procedures.
